Pin Configuration ?

◇Select a pin from the chip diagram to configure its GPIO mode, Alternate Function, or analog mode.

Package view ?

TSSOP20

Click a pin to configure it. cyan ring = assigned, orange dashed = suggested free pin, orange ⚡ = clock pin (HSE/LSE), blinking red = busy.

Detected & configured peripherals

Enable & Configure Peripherals ?

Enable a peripheral (UART, SPI, I2C, timer…). A red card means a required pin is busy. Use “Mark Pins” to see suggested pins, then assign with one click.

Clock sources ?

Clock Sources

HSI — Internal RC
Default internal frequency after reset
HSE — External Crystal
External crystal on pins PF0/PF1
Crystal frequency (MHz)
LSI — 32.768 kHz RC
Clock source for IWDG / LPTIM
LSE — 32.768 kHz Crystal
32.768 kHz crystal on pins PA9/PA10
PLL
PLL multiplier from HSI or HSE (up to the series limit)
PLL source and multiplier ×2 — fixed multiplier (not configurable on this series)

Clock tree ?

Clock Block Diagram

The active clock path is highlighted; a block turns red if SYSCLK or PLL exceeds the series limit. Set LPTIM/RTC clock source from their cards in the Pinout tab.

Generated initialization code ?

main.c (HAL-style initialization skeleton)

📂 Upload a Previous Project for Editing ?
Upload main.c to keep your USER CODE blocks, or also add project_settings.json from the same ZIP to restore pins, peripherals, and clock settings too.
No files uploaded yet.

      
Generated code style depends on the selected series: PY32 devices use the py32f0xx / py32f002b HAL drivers, while HK devices use the official StdPeriph library (hk32f103xxxxa / hk32c030xx / hk32f030m). “Download all files” packages main.c, the required drivers (Drivers/), and a README into a ZIP. Keep your own code only inside USER CODE BEGIN/END so it stays intact after each regeneration.

    

  







  OpenMCU Cube is an unofficial, unaffiliated open-source tool — not affiliated with Puya Semiconductor or Hangshun (HK). Pin maps, alternate-function tables, and clock-tree structures are based on the official datasheets for PY32F030 / F002A / F002B and HK32F030M / F0301M / C030 / F103. Always verify against the latest official datasheet and reference manual before building hardware.
